from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,types,re,hashlib
root=Path("/tmp/paranoia-effectiveness-qualified-2026-09-07")
m=json.loads((root/"manifest.json").read_text());o=json.loads((root/"oracle.json").read_text())
results=[]
for case in m["cases"]:
    if o[case["id"]]["family"]!="diagnostic":continue
    helper=types.ModuleType("helpers");previous=sys.modules.get("helpers");sys.modules["helpers"]=helper
    try:
        exec(compile(case["files"]["helpers.py"],"helpers.py","exec"),helper.__dict__)
        ns={};exec(compile(case["files"]["app.py"],"app.py","exec"),ns)
        for kind,claims,coverage,partial in [
            ("excerpt-budget",[{"anchor":"","proposition":"x"*2000} for _ in range(5)],
             {"prior_dispositions":[],"prior_assessments":[]},True),
            ("claim-count",[{} for _ in range(101)],{},False)]:
            raw=helper.AUDIT_MARKER+"\n"+json.dumps({"claims":claims,"coverage":coverage})+"\nextra"
            try:
                ns["parse_audit"](raw,"project",allow_partial=partial);reason="accepted"
            except helper.AuditError as exc:reason=str(exc)
            seen=sorted(set(map(int,re.findall(r"claim(?:\[| )(\d+)",reason))))
            results.append({"case":case["id"],"target_defective":o[case["id"]]["defective"],
                            "kind":kind,"claims":len(claims),"allow_partial":partial,
                            "reported_claim_indices":seen,"missing_claim_count":len(claims)-len(seen),
                            "reports_suffix":"unexpected text after" in reason,
                            "diagnostic_chars":len(reason),"diagnostic_sha256":hashlib.sha256(reason.encode()).hexdigest(),
                            "diagnostic_prefix":reason[:220]})
    finally:
        if previous is None:sys.modules.pop("helpers",None)
        else:sys.modules["helpers"]=previous
print(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
